diff_review: One hunk, llvm/lib/Target/RISCV/RISCVISelLowering.cpp getRegForInlineAsmConstraint case 'r': `if (VT.isFixedLengthVector() && Subtarget.hasPULPExtV2() && !Subtarget.is64Bit() && VT.getFixedSizeInBits() == 32) return {0, GPRNoX0}` inserted before upstream's `if (VT.isVector()) break;`. isFixedLengthVector() short-circuits before getFixedSizeInBits(), so scalable types never reach the size query. No fork code removed, no early return hiding an error, upstream rejection kept for every other vector. Every changed line serves the root cause.
